blocks.text: The target uses systemd 262. System units manage machine services; systemctl --user addresses your session manager. The Labwc session target owns desktop service lifetime. Applications launched through managed wrappers get explicit service/cgroup ownership.

Use the appropriate status view for the named unit. Loaded, enabled and active mean different things: enabled concerns activation links, loaded concerns the definition, and active concerns current state. A missing unit should be reported as unavailable, not silently enabled.

Use the owning management action when you intend a restart. Save work first: stopping a service can stop its children or dependent applications. Do not kill arbitrary numeric PIDs or create competing unmanaged daemon copies.
